The General Fund cash budget schedule prints no such rows (noncash financing), so neither is in detail[]. Added lines: 38,449 + 186,479 = 224,928 = statement. Remaining difference in schedule_gap.py: it picks debt-proceeds lines by label words (bond|loan|note|proceed|issuance|warrant|lease); 'Subscription financing' matches none, so the script will still show 186,479 short until it recognises 'subscription'.
